obligations.description: Select the conversation membership of the user named Robert who reacted with the eyes emoji to the circuit-tracer rewrite-update message, and report the channel and join time of that membership; two same-name candidates (Robert Walsh in #engineering, Robert Chen in #core-infra) remain unresolved by the prompt.

task_spec.text: Find the user named Robert who reacted with 👀 to the circuit-tracer rewrite-update message.
Report which channel his conversation membership is in and when he joined it.

access_plan: Use conversations.list/history plus reactions.get across accessible channels to locate messages phrased as circuit-tracer rewrite updates and their 'eyes' reactors; use users.info to confirm the reactor's real name starts with Robert; then use conversations.members or channel_members lookups to retrieve each matching Robert's membership (channel and joined_at) in the channel containing his qualifying reaction.
